FIELDS.NAME: Stitch & Style Embroidery Co.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: At Stitch & Style Embroidery Co., we specialize in high-quality embroidery and custom apparel production. Our core operations include utilizing commercial-grade embroidery and printing equipment to create customized garments for businesses, schools, and organizations. We emphasize quality control throughout our production process, ensuring that every item meets our strict standards before it reaches our customers. Our facility is compliant with all local zoning and occupancy regulations, and we maintain an active workers' compensation policy to protect our employees. Additionally, we have robust health and safety protocols in place that include training on machinery usage and best practices for handling materials. We work with established suppliers to source our fabrics and materials, ensuring timeliness and quality in our production chain. Overall, our operations focus solely on embroidery and custom apparel, aligning with our commitment to maintaining a safe and productive environment.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On 04/15/2023, we experienced water damage due to a plumbing issue that resulted in the loss of some inventory and equipment valued at $5,000. The claim is currently under review with our insurance provider.
FIELDS.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Friday: 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM; Saturday: 10:00 AM - 2:00 PM; Closed Sunday
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Fire-resistant safe (Class B, UL rated) for storing sensitive documents and inventory.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security personnel on-site during operational hours to enhance theft prevention and overall safety.

FIELDS.G2: Are athletic teams sponsored?: Yes – We do sponsor athletic teams by providing customized apparel for their uniforms and events as part of our embroidery and custom apparel services.
FIELDS.G3: Are sub-contractors allowed to work: No – Subcontractors are not allowed to work without providing a certificate of insurance, as this helps mitigate potential liability risks. The certificates are typically checked by the operations manager or designated compliance personnel within the company.

FIELDS.G6: Do you lease employees to or from ot: No – We do not lease employees to or from other employers; all our staff are directly employed by Stitch & Style Embroidery Co.
FIELDS.G7: Any Workers Compensation carried?: Yes – We maintain an active workers' compensation policy to protect our employees and ensure compliance with legal requirements.
FIELDS.G8: Do you own or operate any other busi: No – We do not own or operate any other businesses; our focus is solely on Stitch & Style Embroidery Co. for embroidery and custom apparel production.
FIELDS.G9: Any other insurance with this compan: No – We currently do not have any other insurance policies with this company aside from the active policy mentioned.
FIELDS.G10: Are you involved in manufacturing,: No – We are not involved in manufacturing, mixing, relabeling, or repackaging of products; our operations are solely focused on embroidery and custom apparel production.
FIELDS.G11: Do you rent or loan equipment to ot: No – We do not rent or loan equipment to others, as our operations focus solely on in-house embroidery and custom apparel production. This helps us maintain quality control and mitigate potential liability risks.
FIELDS.G12: Has applicant had a foreclosure, re: No – The applicant has not had a foreclosure, repossession, bankruptcy, judgment, or lien during the past five years.
FIELDS.G13: Any exposure to flammables, explosi: No – Our operations solely focus on embroidery and custom apparel production, and we do not have any exposure to flammables, explosives, or chemicals.
FIELDS.G14: Any catastrophe exposure?: No – Stitch & Style Embroidery Co. does not have any catastrophe exposure related to its operations, as we solely focus on embroidery and custom apparel production, which does not involve high-risk activities. Our operations are compliant with all safety and zoning regulations to minimize any potential risks.
FIELDS.G15: Any past losses or claims relating: No – There have been no past losses or claims relating to sexual abuse or molestation allegations, discrimination, or negligent hiring at Stitch & Style Embroidery Co. We maintain strict hiring practices and compliance with all regulations to mitigate such risks.
FIELDS.G16: Any uncorrected fire code violation: No – There are no uncorrected fire code violations. Our facility complies with all local fire safety regulations and maintains regular inspections to ensure safety standards are met.
